rules.description: Portal public assets: respect origin cache headers
rules.expression: (http.host in {"bobbycn.cc" "www.bobbycn.cc"} and http.cookie eq "" and not any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") and http.request.uri.path.extension in {"css" "js" "mjs" "png" "jpg" "jpeg" "gif" "webp" "avif" "svg" "ico" "woff" "woff2" "ttf" "otf" "eot" "wasm" "mp4" "webm" "ogg" "mp3" "wav"})

rules.description: Portal anonymous static HTML: origin sets 60 second edge TTL
rules.expression: (http.host in {"bobbycn.cc" "www.bobbycn.cc"} and http.cookie eq "" and not any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") and (http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/index.html"} or ((starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/games/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/posts/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/resources/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sponsor/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/hosted/")) and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/index.html")))))

rules.description: Portal private routes and sessions: bypass cache (keep last)
rules.expression: (http.host in {"bobbycn.cc" "www.bobbycn.cc"} and (http.cookie ne "" or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/api" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/api/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/oauth" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/oauth/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/admin" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/admin/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/account" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/account/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/login" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/login/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/register" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/register/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/reset-password" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/reset-password/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/verify-email" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/verify-email/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/chat" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/chat/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/mail" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/mail/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/secret" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/secret/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/socket.io" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/socket.io/") or http.request.uri.path contains "/." or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/oauth-callback.html") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/sw.js") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/service-worker.js") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/retire-remaster-sw.js") or http.request.uri.path.extension in {"webmanifest" "map"}))
